glance.h2: What a 1-Bed vs. a 2-Bed Actually Costs
glance.lede: Almost every home at Camino Villas is a 2-bedroom, 2-bath condo, with a few 1-bedrooms. Here's what each has sold for recently: the last 12 months, or a longer window where fewer than three sold.
glance.ratio: Over the last 5 years, 41 of 47 sales were 2-bedrooms. A 1-bedroom comes up about once a year, so if you want one, be ready to move when it lists.

life.lead: Built in 1993–1997, Camino Villas is one of Carmel Valley's larger condo communities: 316 homes along two quiet loop streets, set among mature trees and lush common grounds. Nearly every home is a 2-bedroom, 2-bath condo of about 950 sq ft, which makes it one of the more affordable ways into a 92130 address. See the full Camino Villas community profile.
reasons: The pool, spa and tennis courts sit among landscaping that has had 30 years to grow in.
Walk to the center of Carmel Valley.
The recreation center is about 8 minutes on foot, and One Paseo, Piazza Carmel and Del Mar Highlands are all within about 15 minutes.
With dozens of near-identical 2-bedroom sales, it's easy to see what a unit is worth and whether a list price is fair.

hoa.intro: One monthly fee covers the grounds and the shared amenities.
hoa.fee_note: Most 2025 sales listed $420; 2026 listings show $420–$450. Confirm the current fee for a specific unit.
hoa.also: landscaping, exterior building maintenance and common-area upkeep. Listings show a sauna and guest parking as well.
hoa.compare_note: Camino Villas' dues sit in the middle for nearby condos. Ranges are from 2025–2026 MLS listings.

faq.q: What do Camino Villas condos sell for?
What are the monthly dues at Camino Villas?
faq.a: MLS listings show $375–$450 a month. Most 2025 sales listed $420, and 2026 listings show $420–$450. The fee covers the pool, spa, tennis courts, fitness room, landscaping and exterior maintenance. Confirm the current fee for a specific unit.
Yes. Most recent listings show a Mello-Roos (Community Facilities District) assessment of about $366–$540 a year on top of the regular property tax. Ask for the exact figure on a unit's tax bill.

faq.q: How big are the condos at Camino Villas?
faq.a: 1-bedroom, 1-bath condos are about 624 sq ft, and 2-bedroom, 2-bath condos are about 944–974 sq ft. Over the last 5 years, 41 of 47 sales were 2-bedrooms.

faq.q: What amenities does Camino Villas have?
faq.a: A pool and spa, tennis courts, a fitness room and mature, resort-style landscaping. Listings also show a sauna, assigned carport parking and guest parking.

faq.q: How quickly do Camino Villas condos sell?
faq.a: About 9 homes a year have sold here over the last 5 years, with a median of about 17 days on the market.

Listings show Carmel Del Mar Elementary (Del Mar Union), Carmel Valley Middle School and Torrey Pines High School (San Dieguito Union). Canyon Crest Academy is a district-wide option. School assignments can change, so confirm with each district for a specific address.

faq.q: How does Camino Villas compare to Arborlake next door?
faq.a: Arborlake is older (1986–1989), built around a lake, with higher dues ($450–$460) and no Mello-Roos. Camino Villas is newer and larger, with mostly 2-bedroom, 2-bath condos and lower dues, but a small Mello-Roos assessment.
